name: SG Video Editor
description: Multi-clip video editor with timeline, preview, and MP4 export.

api.note: window.__tool live after tool:ready. Holds project state in-memory; assets stored as Blobs in an internal AssetRegistry. No network calls, no localStorage. Composer + MediaRecorder do MP4 export client-side.

loadAsset.description: Probe a video or image file and register it in the asset registry.

addClip.description: Append a clip referencing an asset to a track at a given timeline start. Throws Error{code:'overlap'} if the new position would overlap another clip on the same track. Pass `snap: true` to auto-snap-abut to the nearest neighbour edge on overlap (used by drag-drop).

trimClip.description: Update inPoint/outPoint of a clip; clamps to asset duration and snaps to fps. Throws Error{code:'overlap'} if the new position would overlap another clip on the same track.

removeClip.description: Remove a clip by id from whichever track contains it.

moveClip.description: Set timelineStart of a clip; snaps to fps. Throws Error{code:'overlap'} if the new position would overlap another clip on the same track. Pass `snap: true` to auto-snap-abut to the nearest neighbour edge on overlap (used by drag-on-timeline).

splitClip.description: Split a clip at a timeline-time, producing two clips that share the asset.

setClipColor.description: Set or clear (color=null) a clip's optional color override; inline style overrides the auto-shade.

setClipTransform.description: Set or clear (transform=null) a clip's per-frame transform {x: 0..1, y: 0..1, scale: 0.05..8} (centre-x/y in canvas, scale multiplies aspect-fit size). Clamped on input.

setClipCrop.description: Set or clear (crop=null) a clip's per-frame source crop {x: 0..1, y: 0..1, w: 0..1, h: 0..1} (sub-rect of source frame). Clamped on input.

getProject.description: Return a defensive deep clone of the current project state.

setProject.description: Replace the current project state (validated via composer-schema).

undo.description: Undo the most recent mutation (snapshot stack, max 50). Returns { undid, canUndo, canRedo }.

redo.description: Redo the most recently undone mutation. Returns { redid, canUndo, canRedo }.

canUndo.description: Report whether undo is currently available.

canRedo.description: Report whether redo is currently available.

addTrack.description: Append a new video track at the top of the z-order. Pass `insertAboveTrackId` to insert directly above an existing track instead. Returns { trackId }.

removeTrack.description: Remove a track and all its clips by trackId. Throws Error{code:'invalid-arg'} if it would leave zero video tracks.

moveClipToTrack.description: Atomically move a clip to another track. Pass `timelineStart` to position it at a chosen time on the destination (defaults to the clip's current start). Pass `snap: true` to snap-abut on overlap. Throws Error{code:'overlap'} if the destination position collides and snap can't clear it.

reorderTracks.description: Reorder video tracks by id (bottom-up). trackIds must contain every existing video-track id exactly once.

setTrackMuted.description: Set or clear a track's mute flag. Top-most active unmuted clip drives audio.

setTrackLocked.description: Set or clear a track's lock flag. Locked tracks reject addClip/addShapeClip/addTextClip/moveClip/trimClip/removeClip/removeTrack and any cross-track move INTO or FROM the locked lane (Error{code:'locked'}). Mute, lock-toggle, and rename are NOT gated.

renameTrack.description: Set or clear a track's display name. Empty/whitespace clears the override; UI falls back to the default `Track N` label. Locked tracks may still be renamed.

copyClip.description: Copy a clip to the in-memory clipboard (single slot). Strips id and timelineStart from the payload — those are picked at paste time. Returns { hasClipboard: true }.

pasteClip.description: Paste the clipboard payload onto a target track at a given time. Honours snap / maxSnapDistance like addClip. Throws Error{code:'invalid-arg'} if the clipboard is empty or the source asset has been removed; Error{code:'locked'} if the target track is locked.

hasClipboard.description: Report whether copyClip has populated the clipboard. Returns { hasClipboard: boolean }.

exportMp4.description: Render the project to an MP4 Blob via the composer; returns blob+meta.

refreshPreview.description: Force the preview canvas to repaint at the current playhead. Escape hatch when the canvas gets out of sync (e.g. after a transform tweak); cheap (just calls the composer's paintAt). Returns { ok: boolean } where ok is false if no composer is currently attached. The transport-bar redraw button (↻) calls this same chokepoint.

events.name: tool:ready
events.when: activate() called

events.name: sg-timeline:clip-added
events.when: user drops a clip onto the timeline

events.name: sg-timeline:clip-moved
events.when: user drags a clip on the timeline

events.name: sg-timeline:clip-trimmed
events.when: user drags a clip edge

events.name: sg-timeline:clip-selected
events.when: user clicks a clip

events.name: sg-timeline:clip-deleted
events.when: user clicks the clip x or presses Del

events.name: sg-timeline:clip-split
events.when: user presses S with a clip selected

events.name: sg-timeline:clip-color-requested
events.when: user picks a colour for the selected clip in the timeline toolbar

events.name: sg-timeline:undo-requested
events.when: user clicks the timeline Undo button

events.name: sg-timeline:redo-requested
events.when: user clicks the timeline Redo button

events.name: sg-timeline:playhead-changed
events.when: user scrubs the timeline ruler

events.name: sg-timeline:track-add-requested
events.when: user clicks the +Track toolbar button

events.name: sg-timeline:track-remove-requested
events.when: user clicks the × button on a lane header

events.name: sg-timeline:track-mute-requested
events.when: user clicks the M toggle on a lane header

events.name: sg-timeline:track-lock-requested
events.when: user clicks the lock toggle on a lane header

events.name: sg-timeline:track-renamed
events.when: user commits a rename via the inline input

events.name: sg-timeline:track-selected
events.when: user clicks a lane header label / area

events.name: sg-timeline:clip-copied
events.when: user clicks Copy or Cmd-drags a clip

events.name: sg-timeline:clip-paste-requested
events.when: user clicks the Paste button on the timeline toolbar

events.name: sg-timeline:clip-track-changed
events.when: user drags a clip to a different lane and drops

events.name: tool:error
events.when: any pipeline error
